dogecoin.text:
The main purpose of Dogecoin was to raise awareness of blockchain technology. 
Dogecoin's blockchain is based on Litecoin, which was a fork of the Bitcoin blockchain. 
Dogecoin has an unlimited supply and is known for its low price.

Dogecoin (DOGE) was created in December 2013 by software engineers Bill Marcus and Jackson Palmer. ExplanationDogecoin is a cryptocurrency that uses open-source code and the Scrypt algorithm. It's considered an altcoin, and its logo is a Shiba Inu dog named Kabosu.
